finding: oracle_scan drops every tool_result flagged is_error; diff/sdiff/git diff --no-index exit 1 when the operands differ and Claude Code records that as is_error:true with the output kept, so the canonical probe `diff pr/head/X X` is never counted. remediation: Skip only when content is empty or every line matches ERR_LINE/^Exit code \d+$; otherwise strip the exit line and parse. Flip AG-48 case 9; add a Claude Code-shaped case.

finding: A zero-argument method call inside a Python heredoc (out.pop(), conn.close()) matches as a bash function header and splits or extends the enclosing scope.

critique: Regex scope detection has no heredoc awareness and makes the brace optional.
remediation: Disallow '.' in the name, require '{', clip nested spans to the parent's end; add an RG case with a heredoc method call.

finding: A multi-line def signature (`def f(\n    x,\n):`) ends the Python definition at line 2; the body is top-level and gets no same-scope credit.

critique: Dedent rule applied before the header is complete.
remediation: Use ast FunctionDef.lineno/end_lineno (tokenize fallback) or carry the header through balanced parentheses to the ':' line.
